The harness runs one runSteps(1) per state; captured logicalTime advances by 1/60 s. This validates the harness's logical timebase, not render or network packet rates of the official client.

PhysicsCore2D implements adaptive substeps; Node-Haxball bundled Nago World.E$ integrates once for a supplied step and solves contacts sequentially. Core stepWorld does not use Physics2D.Config.collisionIterations/maxCollisionSubsteps/collisionSubstepRadiusFraction names; it reads maxSubsteps and hardcodes fraction 0.5.

parameters.value: Core repeats per-disc pairs then planes/segments per substep; Nago performs a single sequential pass of pairs then planes/segments/vertices and two joint passes
parameters.evidence: Direct source comparison of active Core.stepWorld and Node-Haxball 2.3.0 embedded Nago N.prototype.E$.
